text:
Type: wall-mounted hexagon tealight holder
Use: candle light on a wall above a sofa, console or bed; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: glam, modern, art deco
Materials: gold-finish metal frame, clear glass votives
Colors: warm gold, clear
Shape: wide horizontal row of overlapping hexagon outlines with five glass tealight cups, slim and open
Feel: glowing, elegant, airy
Goes with: white or dark walls, marble, velvet, brass accents; glam or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Metal Wall Mounted Hexagon Tealight Candle Holder Decor - 11.5"H, Gold
product.description: Add romance and glamour to your space with this wall-mounted tealight candle holder. Gold-finished metal forms a series of five conjoined hexagons, each with a glass holder. Even in the daytime, this piece adds a sleek modern touch to your room. 34.25" W x 11.5" H x 3.75" D This tealight holder is functional while adding modern glamour to your wall Metal with gold finish; glass tealight holders
